distanceRationale: Mathlib has the adele ring of a number field with its finite and infinite parts. Tau Ceti has classical modular forms, newforms with strong multiplicity one and GL₂ Hecke rings. None of the representation-theoretic layer exists: smooth admissible representations of GL₂ over local fields, Whittaker and Kirillov models, newvector theory and local factors, automorphic forms and cuspidal spectral decomposition for GL₂ over number fields, converse theorems, and local Langlands for GL₂. Also missing are the invariant and simple trace formulas with their transfer inputs, Jacquet–Langlands, cyclic base change and Langlands–Tunnell. These are deep established theorems resting on several unbuilt research-level theories.
